26548-the-tale-of-a-trooper.creator: Unknown
26548-the-tale-of-a-trooper.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Charley and Mac had come thus far on their way out to have a look at the stock in the big paddocks higher in the hills, before the thickening snow had made purposeless their going further.

arxiv-2207-12394.title: Dynamic 3D Scene Analysis by Point Cloud Accumulation
arxiv-2207-12394.creator: Shengyu Huang Zan Gojcic Jiahui Huang, Andreas Wieser Konrad Schindler
arxiv-2207-12394.description: Abstract Multi-beam LiDAR sensors, as used on autonomous vehicles and mobile robots, acquire sequences of 3D range scans (“frames”). Each frame covers the scene sparsely, due to limited angular scanning resolution and occlusion. The sparsity restricts the performance of downstream processes like semantic segmentation or surface reconstruction.

arxiv-2303-14928.title: Verification Of Partial Quantifier Elimination
arxiv-2303-14928.creator: Eugene Goldberg
arxiv-2303-14928.description: Abstract Quantifier elimination (QE) is an important problem that has numerous applications. Unfortunately, QE is computationally very hard. Earlier we introduced a generalization of QE called partial QE (or PQE for short). PQE allows to unquantify a part of the formula. The appeal of PQE is twofold. First, many important problems can be solved in terms of PQE.

arxiv-2305-06345.title: Magnetic Catalysis in Holographic Model with Two Types of Anisotropy for Heavy Quarks
arxiv-2305-06345.creator: Irina Ya. Aref’eva, Ali Hajilou, Kristina Rannu, Pavel Slepov
arxiv-2305-06345.description: Abstract In our previous paper [ 1 ] we have constructed a twice anisotropic five-dimensional holographic model supported by Einstein-dilaton-three-Maxwell action that reproduced some essential features of the “heavy quarks” model. However, that model did not describe the magnetic catalysis (MC) phenomena expected from lattice results for the QGP made up from heavy quarks.

arxiv-2308-13816.title: Homological Convolutional Neural Networks
arxiv-2308-13816.creator: Antonio Briola, Yuanrong Wang, Silvia Bartolucci, Tomaso Aste
arxiv-2308-13816.description: Abstract Deep learning methods have demonstrated outstanding performances on classification and regression tasks on homogeneous data types (e.g., image, audio, and text data). However, tabular data still pose a challenge, with classic machine learning approaches being often computationally cheaper and equally effective than increasingly complex deep learning architectures.

arxiv-2407-11326.title: HEROS: Hierarchical Exploration with Online Subregion Updating for 3D Environment Coverage
arxiv-2407-11326.creator: Shijun Long, Ying Li, Chenming Wu, Bin Xu, Wei Fan
arxiv-2407-11326.description: Abstract We present an autonomous exploration system for efficient coverage of unknown environments. First, a rapid environment preprocessing method is introduced to provide environmental information for subsequent exploration planning. Then, the whole exploration space is divided into multiple subregion cells, each with varying levels of detail.

arxiv-2501-11008.title: Institute of Nuclear Physics,
arxiv-2501-11008.creator: Polish Academy of Sciences, Cracow, Poland
arxiv-2501-11008.description: Abstract Thermal conductivity of 3C-SiC from configuration space sampling Paweł T. Jochym \star and Jan Łażewski Abstract Cubic silicon carbide phonon thermal conductivity has been calculated using anharmonic phonon analysis. The atomic interaction model was built using displacement-force data obtained with the High Efficiency Configuration Space Sampling (HECSS) technique and density functional theory calculated forces.

arxiv-2511-12316.title: BlinDNO: A Distributional Neural Operator for Dynamical System Reconstruction from Time-Label-Free data Thanks: Submitted to the editors DATE.
arxiv-2511-12316.creator: Zhijun Zeng, Junqing Chen, Zuoqiang Shi
arxiv-2511-12316.description: Abstract We study an inverse problem for stochastic and quantum dynamical systems in a time-label-free setting, where only unordered density snapshots—sampled at unknown times drawn from an observation-time distribution ν t \nu_{t} —are available. These observations induce a distribution over state densities, from which we seek to recover the parameters of the underlying evolution operator.

pmc-10562254.title: Structure and function of rice hybrid genomes reveal genetic basis and optimal performance of heterosis
pmc-10562254.creator: Zhoulin Gu, Junyi Gong, Zhou Zhu, Zhen Li, Qi Feng, Changsheng Wang, Yan Zhao, Qilin Zhan, Congcong Zhou, Ahong Wang, Tao Huang, Lei Zhang, Qilin Tian, Danlin Fan, Yiqi Lu, Qiang Zhao, Xuehui Huang, Shihua Yang, Bin Han
pmc-10562254.description: Exploitation of crop heterosis is crucial for increasing global agriculture production. However, the quantitative genomic analysis of heterosis was lacking, and there is currently no effective prediction tool to optimize cross-combinations. Here 2,839 rice hybrid cultivars and 9,839 segregation individuals were resequenced and phenotyped.

pmc-10642749.title: A meta-analysis of the association between post-traumatic stress disorder and cancer risk
pmc-10642749.creator: Juanjuan Yang, Wei Jiang
pmc-10642749.description: BackgroundSeveral studies have investigated the link between post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) and cancer risk but reported mixed results. The objective of our study was to investigate the association between PTSD and cancer risk.MethodsStudies published in English about the relationship between PTSD and cancer incidence were systematically searched.

pmc-11319044.title: Bartonella henselae Hepatic Abscesses and Associated Osteomyelitis in a Pediatric Patient
pmc-11319044.creator: Molly Antonson, Lauren Klingemann, Kari Neemann
pmc-11319044.description: Bartonella henselae is a Gram-negative bacillus transmitted to humans via cat saliva or scratch. Cat scratch disease, the typical clinical manifestation of B. henselae infection, presents as localized cutaneous or regional lymphadenopathy. Rare, atypical presentations, generally reflecting bloodborne disseminated disease, can include hepatosplenic, cardiac, ocular, neurologic, or musculoskeletal involvement. Here, we present a case of disseminated B.

pmc-11590272.title: How to construct and deliver an elevator pitch: a formula for the research scientist
pmc-11590272.creator: Leslie A Caromile, Ankita Jha, Jaye C Gardiner, Ozlem Dilek, Ryoma Ohi, Lee Ligon
pmc-11590272.description: ly adopted the elevator pitch as a highly effective means of quickly engaging with an audience, establishing a connection, and introducing themselves and their research interests. The elevator pitch is named after the brief ride in an elevator that usually lasts less than a minute.

pmc-12554608.title: Real-world safety of ixekizumab: a disproportionality analysis using the FDA adverse event reporting system and the VigiAccess databases
pmc-12554608.creator: Kaidi Zhao, Xuanfeng Tan, Miao Qin, Qinxiao Li, Qinqin Meng, Ying Liu, Jing Li, Jiashu Liu
pmc-12554608.description: IntroductionIxekizumab is a biologic agent primarily indicated for the treatment of moderate to-severe plaque psoriasis. This study aimed to evaluate the post-marketing safety profile of ixekizumab by analyzing adverse event (AE) reports retrieved from the Food and Drug Administration Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS) database and VigiAccess databases.

pmc-12730077.title: From Pressure to Peril: Investigating the Drivers of Suicide Planning and Attempts in University Students Struggling with Academic Anxiety
pmc-12730077.creator: Gulzar H. Shah, Masha Asad Khan, Maham Muzamil, Mahira Ahmed
pmc-12730077.description: Self-harm is a growing public health concern, particularly among university students facing academic anxiety. This study explored the underlying factors driving suicide planning and attempts in this population. Using a qualitative design, we conducted thematic analysis of interviews with eight counselors and eight students from five public and private universities.

pmc-12764898.title: Barrier impermeability is associated with migratory ungulate survival rates
pmc-12764898.creator: Kyle Joly, Chloe Beaupré, Timothy J. Fullman, Matthew D. Cameron, Nicole Barbour, Eliezer Gurarie
pmc-12764898.description: Barriers can affect the movement, migratory patterns, and demographic rates of ungulates. Even in highly remote areas with relatively little development, like northwest Alaska, isolated roads can alter the movements of ungulates such as caribou (Rangifer tarandus). Here, a solitary, 80-km long industrial road connecting a large zinc and lead mine to a port affects caribou migrations.

pmc-13050017.title: Association of a Fixed 1 mg Dose of Granisetron for Preventing Postoperative Nausea and Vomiting (PONV) in Patients Undergoing Laparoscopic Colorectal Surgery With Multiple PONV Risk Factors: A Retrospective Observational Study
pmc-13050017.creator: Takayuki Morimoto, Kentaro Hara, Akihisa Nishigaki, Keiko Tashiro, Akiha Nakao, Kyoko Nagaoka, Michiko Yamaguchi, Tetsuya Hara
pmc-13050017.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). IntroductionGranisetron is a selective 5-hydroxytryptamine type 3 (5-HT3) receptor antagonist approved in Japan for the prophylaxis of postoperative nausea and vomiting (PONV). According to the Japanese package insert, a fixed intravenous dose of 1 mg is recommended; however, evidence for its effectiveness in patients undergoing laparoscopic colorectal surgery in a clinical context characterized by multiple established PONV risk factors remains limited.

pmc-13280968.title: Long‐term demography and spatial genetic structure reveal mechanisms of Sassafras albidum population persistence through clonality
pmc-13280968.creator: J T Michel, Jonathan P Evans, Skyler J Fox, Ashley B Morris
pmc-13280968.description: PremiseVegetative regeneration is a key mechanism of woody plant persistence in forest ecosystems, and the coupled roles of basal sprouting and clonal growth in shaping long‐term population dynamics have been understudied. Basal sprouting replaces stems at fixed ramet locations, whereas clonal growth via root suckering produces spatially distinct ramets that promote genet‐level persistence across space.

pmc-13297641.title: Tripartite Quantum Steering Dynamics in Photonic Systems Under Non-Markovian Dynamics
pmc-13297641.creator: Smail Bougouffa, Kamal Berrada
pmc-13297641.description: We investigate the non-Markovian dynamics of quantum steering in a tripartite photonic system subject to dephasing noise. By developing a theoretical framework based on the single-photon dephasing model extended to three independent photons, we analyze the temporal evolution of steering measures SA−BC and SAB−C for two distinct classes of initial states: W-type entangled states and GHZ-type mixed entangled states.

pmc-13311990.title: A novel corneal epithelial cell culture assay for assessing topical antivirals against herpes simplex virus keratitis
pmc-13311990.creator: Hidenobu Kuniyoshi, Yui Numata, Mina Sasano, Hironori Hayashi, Nobuo Fuse, Stefan G Sarafianos, Eiichi N Kodama

pmc-13317578.title: Efficient Electrocatalytic Conversion of CO2 to Pure Formic Acid Solutions via Strain‐Engineered Bismuth Nanosheets
pmc-13317578.creator: Shiqi Li, Yuefeng Zhang, Panzhe Qiao, Cuo Wu, Xinya Tian, Yufeng Xu, Yun Zhang, Peng Wang, Tingting Li, Muhammad Afaq, Xinlin Luo, Tang Wang, Chunxiao Liu, Zi‐You Yu, Chuan Xia, Min‐Rui Gao, Zhen‐Yu Wu
pmc-13317578.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The electrochemical reduction of CO2 to formic acid (HCOOH), a valuable chemical feedstock, offers a promising pathway toward carbon neutrality. However, achieving high selectivity, industrial current densities, long‐time stability, and the direct production of pure products simultaneously remains difficult. Here we present tensile‐strained bismuth nanosheets (TS‐BiNs) created through a scalable mechanochemical ball‐milling and carbonation process, effectively addressing all of these challenges.

pmc-13371699.title: Healthcare under fire: a retrospective analysis of a national ngo response during the 2024 conflict in Lebanon
pmc-13371699.creator: Rana El Haidari, Adnan Husseini, Kassem Baydoun, Rima Badran, Samir Mansour, Abbas Hoballah
pmc-13371699.description: BackgroundThe 2024 conflict in Lebanon triggered widespread internal displacement and placed significant strain on the national health system. This study analyzes the emergency healthcare response of the Health Society during Lebanon’s 2024 conflict using a health systems resilience framework and SWOT analysis to inform evidence-based interventions for conflict-affected populations and guide future policy and research.

pmc-13400207.title: TMC7 promotes colorectal cancer metastasis via inhibition of PKN2 and regulation of hypoxia-adaptive responses
pmc-13400207.creator: Yun Zhu, Anni Luo, Xing Liu, Yongxin Zhang, Xiangzhao Li, Qingqing Zhang, Yi Lei, Yanqi Li, Yang Cheng
pmc-13400207.description: Highlights•TMC7 is significantly upregulated in colorectal cancer, with the highest expression level in metastatic lesions of CRC.•High TMC7 expression predicts poor prognosis, severe liver metastasis and unsatisfactory immunotherapy/chemotherapy response in CRC.•A novel TMC7–PKN2–HIF1α axis drives CRC metastasis via hypoxia adaptation and Warburg effect-mediated metabolic reprogramming.•TMC7 inhibits PKN2 to facilitate HIF1α nuclear translocation and activate glycolysis, supporting CRC tumor survival.
